gloss: to separate; to isolate; to detach

definitions.gloss: to separate; to isolate; to detach
definitions.explanation: To divide something that was joined or mixed into distinct parts, or for something to come apart from a whole. Used both transitively (to separate X) and intransitively (X separates).

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分離|ぶんり}する。
⟦ロケット→ロケット：00353_roketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一段目|いちだんめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}されて→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{分離|ぶんり}した。
examples.english: The rocket's first stage was jettisoned and separated from the main body.

notes:
Describes the process of dividing connected or mixed things into separate parts. Can be used both for physical separation (chemicals, mechanical parts) and abstract separation (concepts, institutions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政教|せいきょう}⟦{分離|ぶんり}→分離：11773_bunri⟧: separation of church and state
- ⟦{分離|ぶんり}→分離：11773_bunri⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧: secession and independence
- ⟦{分離|ぶんり}→分離：11773_bunri⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧: separation anxiety
- ⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分離|ぶんり}する: to separate components
- ⟦{分離|ぶんり}→分離：11773_bunri⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: separation surgery (e.g., conjoined twins)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide / to separate — everyday word, broader usage
- ⟦{隔離|かくり}する→隔離する：25538_kakurisuru⟧: to isolate / to quarantine — emphasizes keeping apart, especially for safety
- ⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}す→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧: to detach / to cut off — physical detachment with a sense of severing
- ⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}する→分割する：21140_bunkatsusuru⟧: to divide / to split — dividing into portions, often equally

REGISTER:
Formal. Standard in scientific, legal, and technical writing. In everyday speech, ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ or ⟦{離|はな}す→離す：19372_hanasu⟧ are more common.
